dse_runs.notes: High-precision coherent demod: max_abs_err <= 2^-20 (~9.54e-7) at >= 50 MSPS. Tight error constraint — favor pipelined families with enough stages/precision; iterative designs may struggle on throughput. Selection rule: min luts_plus_ffs, so keep the small-area end of the front well populated.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **high_precision** was taken down the full ladder and finalized: L1 used all 400 evaluations in the structured DSE graph (refine → refine → stop), yielding a feasible front with the selection `pipelined:data_width=23, n_iter=22, angle_guard=4, frac_guard=3, rounding=round` — luts_plus_ffs=3833, power_index=7.21, 249 MSPS, max_abs_err 9.39e-07 (2^-20.02, within the 2^-20 constraint). L2 system simulation confirmed the design (no system scenario, so selection unchanged; DDS SFDR 141.9 dBc, SNR 128.9 dB). L3/L4 had no recorded rows for this config (fresh W=23 verification too heavy for a live campaign; L4 is recorded-only), so back_annotate found no measured data and no winner change was flagged — no reexplore needed. Final selection stands on L1 estimates plus L2 simulation.
